built.D1: A matched candidate accepted by a stored evidence confirmation becomes a citation on the building's record through the registry correction path (draft, amendment, review, commit). A table row is cited by registry-table-evidence.ts; a document part keeps the native citation with its exact quote (registry-document-evidence.ts). No cell or part value becomes a field. Accepting a several, conflicting or no_match candidate is refused 409 INTAKE_EVIDENCE_NOT_MATCHED, in words.
built.D2: Only a stored confirmation is written. Every pin (profile, source revision, SHA-256 and bytes, reading, package revision and review, candidate hash and evidence) is checked again before the draft and again in the commit transaction; a moved pin refuses 409 INTAKE_EVIDENCE_STALE. One operations receipt per confirmation and building is stored in the commit transaction, so a replay writes nothing.
built.D3: The E1 run has an evidence step between record and snapshot. It writes revision n+1 and stores the evidence artefact; the snapshot pins the cited revision. A building with no confirmation goes on as before. registryWritten is true once every accepted building holds its receipt.
built.D4: The plan accepts 'CSV logical row N' and an evidence citation's pointer; it reads the original again and refuses an excerpt that is not byte-exact. The card quotes each citation exactly from the stored citation, with the file name, the locator in words and 'Evidence confirmed by the officer by an exact key; it states no right or owner.'
built.D5: not built: a confirmation stored after the building is carded is not written by the run (the evidence step runs only before a snapshot exists). The writer already accepts the earlier write's confirmation ids.
